title: Customer records exfiltrated via unauthenticated export API
summary: Bulk download of customer PII (EU + India) through a misconfigured public API.
description: Microsoft Sentinel analytic rule 'Anomalous data volume from public API' fired at 02:14 UTC. Between 23:05 and 02:10 UTC, external IP 203.0.113.45 made 1,840 requests to /api/v2/accounts/export?includeAll=true, which skipped authentication because of a feature flag left on after a release. WAF logs show 50,214 customer records returned (full name, email, phone, IBAN, account balance, date of birth). Customers are mainly in Ireland, Germany and India. The source IP is a hosting provider. No sign so far that internal systems were accessed beyond the API.

sentinel.title: Anomalous data volume from public API
